styleAnchors.rule: Use P01/P02/P03 as V30 publication-family rendering anchors only. Do not copy their layouts. P04 must keep its own travel-memory composition while inheriting saturation, dark outline, bright keyline, controlled shadow, sticker/cutout print feel, tropical/travel rendering and clean paper treatment.

visualMaster.pageRoleSummary: Photo-led travel memories feature: one dominant Okinawa hero, three supporting travel photos, destination labels, a restrained travel-route connector, a closing message and a tropical publication closure.
visualMaster.rule: The actual P04.png controls page-specific hierarchy and composition. Do not infer P04 geometry from older prose or another page.

informationArchitecture: three support photos form lower editorial collage
destination labels attach locally to their corresponding travel memories
closing message occupies lower-right quiet zone
bottom closure supports rather than competes with photos

photoRoles.rule: All four photos remain independent replaceable fills/masks. Never flatten photo pixels into generated display assets. Never crop them from P04.png for production.

modules.rule: Generate as one authored header ecology. Preserve the bold Rurubu-like hierarchy; do not split into isolated flower/airplane/ribbon/icon assets.
One calibrated family, three locally distinct labels. They may vary in color and small floral accents but must share paper/keyline/outline/shadow grammar.
The blue dashed route and airplane are subordinate editorial movement, not a dominant diagram. Prefer integrating them with nearest ecology. Reject flowchart/roadmap/Canva connector treatment.
One bounded support ecology. Keep it bright, pop, printed and cutout-like; no watercolor chapel or vintage travel poster.
Keep the final message text native/editable. Decorative underline/highlight/heart treatment may be separate or bundled as a vessel, but do not flatten personal copy into the image.

fixedVisibleStrings: ふたりで見た景色、ずっと忘れない！♡

closingMessage.visualMasterReference: たくさんの笑顔と／最高の景色を一緒に。／これからも、いろんな景色を／ふたりで見に行こうね！♡
closingMessage.rule: Use the Visual Master as layout/copy reference until owner final copy approval. Do not bake this message into generated imagery.

quietZones: lower-right message area must stay readable and not be invaded by the Hawaii photo, route or bottom closure
faces in all four photos must remain free of labels, route strokes, stamps and tropical ornaments
PAGE 04 badge needs clear breathing room at bottom-right
header subtitle ribbon must remain legible against sky/hero transition
relationalConstraints: header ecology stays above the hero photo and reads first
Okinawa label attaches to the hero memory without covering faces
Korea label stays local to the left support photo
Hawaii label stays local to the right support photo
route connector may travel between memories but must not become a flowchart spine
lower-center support photo remains visibly subordinate to the two side support photos
bottom closure stays behind/below the editorial photo collage and message
PAGE 04 remains a separate shared publication component
layerOrder: shared PAGE 04 component / foreground micro accents

inherit: hot pink / vivid blue / yellow / green / cyan

avoidPaletteDrift.forbiddenDominantPurple: #7e08f9 and nearby saturated purple must not become a major fill/route/background accent unless explicitly owner-approved
avoidPaletteDrift.rule: Use V30 blue/pink/yellow/green as primary route and ornament colors. Dark navy is allowed as outline/shadow.

hardRejects: crop from P04.png used as a photo fill
page screenshot used as photo proxy
isolated airplane/flower/stamp micro-assets pasted around the page when they should belong to an ecology
fake white rescue rectangle behind a badly cut asset
binary alpha accepted solely because the outside is transparent

alphaPolicy.rule: Transparent background is not sufficient. Check intended interior opacity and edge anti-alias/fringe quality on light, gray and dark QA backgrounds. Flower, leaf, ribbon, airplane and curved route edges must not be accepted as hard binary cutouts solely because outside alpha is zero.

representativeEcologyCalibration.failBehavior: Reject/regenerate the header only. Do not generate location labels, route, bottom closure or message vessel until the representative ecology passes.
representativeEcologyCalibration.passBehavior: Scale the accepted rendering language to location-label family, restrained route connector, bottom closure and message vessel.

passBFindings: route connector must stay subordinate and non-diagrammatic
bottom-left stamp/chapel/flowers should be one ecology rather than a clipart pile
lower-center photo needs deliberate overlap/spacing so it does not feel pasted on
message copy remains native to prevent white-box/template drift
destination labels are one family, not unrelated mini-assets
reviewProcess.lockCondition: P04 Visual Master analysis is locked for production planning. Design completion still requires representative ecology calibration, live Figma implementation and final QA.
